theme_strategy: Light and Dark mode supported. Follows 'Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy', prioritizing trust, calm, and functional beauty for personal finance tracking.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import 'Work Sans' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. H1 max size text-4xl.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css with these HSL values. Avoid pure black or white. Use the 'destructive' and 'warning' colors for budget limit alerts.

layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density Grid). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 inside cards. Use 2-3x more spacing between major sections.
layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dashboard widgets use 'h-full'. Mobile-first responsive grids. Never center-everything.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism 'Clay & Crisp' variant. Flat solid surfaces with max 8px border-radius (rounded-md). 1px subtle borders (border-border). No heavy glassmorphism for health/finance apps.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Cards default to shadow-sm. Hover states on interactive cards: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise overlay pattern on the main body background.

components.charts: Use Recharts. Bar chart for 'Expenses vs Limit' by category. Donut chart for 'Expenses breakdown'. Ensure color-blind friendly palettes.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table for transaction history. Clean, horizontal borders only.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Dialog. Buttons should be rounded-md.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (alerts, limits reached, export success).
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. They provide a high-end dense dashboard look.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Install missing packages: `yarn add recharts @phosphor-icons/react sonner date-fns jspdf html2canvas papaparse`. Add Shadcn components as needed.

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Add hover states (transition-colors or transition-transform). Never use 'transition: all' as it breaks transforms. Stagger entrance animations for list items if possible.

accessibility.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure contrast ratios > 4.5:1. Provide visible focus rings on inputs and buttons. ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-expense-button', data-testid='budget-alert-message').

media.instructions_to_main_agent: No stock photos required for this personal dashboard. Do not use placeholder images.

domain_specific_rules.functionality: Ensure you implement custom categories with limits, saving goals with progress, CSV/PDF export, month selector, visual alerts for exceeded limits, and a transaction history with filters.
domain_specific_rules.currency_formatting: Use Intl.NumberFormat to correctly format DOP and other currencies.
domain_specific_rules.export_functionality: Include buttons for exporting data to CSV (e.g., using papaparse or vanilla JS) and PDF (e.g., using jspdf + html2canvas).
domain_specific_rules.data_storage: Since there is no auth (personal use), use localStorage or IndexedDB to persist categories, transactions, goals, and settings.
domain_specific_rules.language: UI and default data MUST be in Spanish as requested.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transitions ('transition: all').
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Never use AI emojis for icons.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Ensure UI is available in Spanish as requested in the original problem statement.
